scope: Presentation of the ten existing X4K3 representative-illustration candidates only; no runtime or clearance approval

decision.detailAndInteractivePreview: The full TMGi/TMGve discrepancy, representative/non-CAD limitation and correct drawing link must be persistently visible beside the detail or interactive 3D preview.
decision.listingAndComparisonTypeIcons: Small representative type icons do not require an additional persistent discrepancy caption. Their accessible title/tooltip must retain the same qualified reason.
decision.rawProductNames: Retain the original TMGi names and all source values.
decision.largerPreviewElsewhere: A larger or interactive construction preview outside the detail page must also show the discrepancy persistently.

rationale: The drawing explicitly includes X4K3 and supports a shared representative type symbol. A small navigation icon does not claim exact execution identity; the detailed construction preview must expose the nomenclature limitation clearly.
